title: The crime scene

In the hallway: blood on the door frame (5) and on a broken wall by the kitchen (6), a door to the backyard, and a bathroom at the end. In the kitchen: a chair on the floor (7), the knife rack on the worktop (8), a baseball bat by the refrigerator (9), and two magazines on the worktop. You can look into one thing at a time. You cannot leave without the lieutenant, and he will not stay here all night.

adaptationNote: The chart’s CRIME SCENE bracket as a repeatable scene: each visit offers what has not been examined yet, one thing at a time; the scene keeps one opaque ID across visits. Every chart node in the bracket is an option, after the report to {{Hank}} (offered only once the investigation is complete), in the order of the police markers, then the bathroom (whose statue is the tenth evidence item; story 1.9.2 moved it up from among the other looks), and then the rest: ANALYZE CARLOS’ BODY (the template’s Body clues), RECONSTRUCT CARLOS’ LAST MOMENTS (needs the body), ANALYZE KNIFE (2), ANALYZE RED ICE (3), the blood at marker 4 (PowerPyx; no chart node of its own), ANALYZE BLOOD ON WALLS (two options, markers 5 and 6, as PowerPyx counts them), EXAMINE CHAIR (7), ANALYZE MISSING KNIFE (8), ANALYZE BASEBALL BAT (9; the template’s Bat clue), RECONSTRUCT ASSAULT WITH BAT (needs the bat), EXAMINE EDEN CLUB FLYER, ANALYZE BACKYARD (the template’s Prints clue; the shoe print reads K52 as in the template), INVESTIGATE WRITING, SAMPLE BLOOD (the template’s Blood clue; in the game any blood can be tasted once), OPEN CLOSET, CHECK SHOWER (chart state CONNOR KNOWS ABOUT RA9), EXAMINE STATUE (needs the shower; chart state CONNOR HAVE SEEN THE STATUE), READ “ANDROID SEX” and READ “ANDROID SPY” (the two magazines are options here, not a separate media scene, because in the game they lie in the kitchen and cost investigation time). Evidence: the investigation is complete (CONNOR KNOWS WHAT HAPPENED, the transcript’s REVIEW EVIDENCE 10/10) once all ten evidence items are reviewed. The wiki transcript prints the REVIEW EVIDENCE n/10 counter under exactly ten interactions: the victim’s reconstruction, the knife, the red ice, the blood at markers 4, 5 and 6, the bathroom (counted once, after the statue, as in its tab), the chair, the missing knife and the bat reconstruction; Read Flyer and Check Backyard have no counter, so they are not evidence (story 1.9.1 counted them, from PowerPyx’s list of eleven, and did not count the bathroom). The statue therefore cannot be missed on a FOUND DEVIANT run. The fastest complete search is thirteen actions (the ten items plus the body scan, the bat scan and the shower that unlock three of them). Then the option to report to {{Hank}} appears; the other looks stay open. Timer (unsourced as a count): the game’s “approximately five minutes” is modelled as 13 actions. If the 13th action leaves the investigation incomplete, {{Hank}} wants to go (the next scenes); if he grants five more minutes, those are 5 further actions, after which he leaves (OUT OF TIME). Once {{Connor}} knows what happened the clock stops (the transcript’s two branches are “Know What Happened” or “Run Out Of Time”). {{Hank}}’s idle moves are the only cue the game gives, so they appear as the clock runs: after 7 actions he opens the closet, tosses the flyer, comments on the red ice and a technician mentions the bathroom; after 10 he wanders the kitchen and eyes the door. {{Hank}}’s reactions to the blood sample (shown only if he is watching, in the game) and to the backyard are part of those outcomes. Each look adds a short fact to {{Connor}}’s knowledge (the four blood looks share one); the full scan text is in the outcome. Left out, no effect and not on the chart: the windows and the curtain that drops the brooms. No stat change in the search itself. Cross-chapter outputs: ch06SawWriting, ch06KnowsRA9, ch06SawStatue (and evidence.statueMap, read by the archive route in Last Chance, {{Connor}}), and ch06Clues for everything examined, including the magazines.
